description: This source file defines structures, functions, and classes related to managing TLS pinning and certificate validation within a WebSocket session, specifically for configuring TLS fingerprint validation and storage in a secure manner.

classes.name: GatewayTLSPinningSession
classes.description: A class managing WebSocket sessions with custom TLS fingerprint verification, handling URL session delegate methods for server trust authentication.

methods.name: loadFingerprint
methods.description: Loads a saved TLS fingerprint from secure storage for a given stable ID.

methods.name: saveFingerprint
methods.description: Stores a TLS fingerprint securely for a specified stable ID.

methods.name: clearFingerprint
methods.description: Removes a stored fingerprint for a given stable ID.

methods.name: makeWebSocketTask
methods.description: Creates a WebSocket task with a specified URL, configured with custom session settings.

methods.name: urlSession(_:didReceive:completionHandler:)
methods.description: Handles server trust authentication challenges, verifying server certificates against expected fingerprints or allowing Tofu (Trust on First Use) strategy.
